attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

This inverse correlation between diversity and constraint quality bounds the method's effective operating regime to near-zero. Validated across 4 domains × 7 models.\\n2. **Operating Regime is Empirically Empty**: Despite instruction models producing high trace diversity (C0=25-50%), symbolic consensus (SICA) provides no accuracy gain over majority voting at scale (804 questions, gap=+0.26pp, n.s.). Across tested conditions, the regime where diversity AND constraint quality are simultaneously sufficient is not realized for current LLMs. Reasoning models (QwQ, DeepSeek-R1) show zero diversity. Instruction models show high diversity but low constraint quality. [Fallback if 1-2 cells positive: \\\"regime exists but is extremely narrow and domain-specific, unreliable for practical deployment.\\\"]\\n3. **C0 as Necessary-but-Insufficient Diagnostic**: C0 reliably predicts when symbolic consensus CANNOT help (C0<5% → method degenerates to SC), but high C0 does NOT guarantee gains. C0 is a zero-cost early stopping criterion for practitioners considering symbolic aggregation methods — not a predictor of benefit.\\n\\n### Previous Claims (pre-D025, retained for reference)\\n1. ~~Principled Tiebreaking improves accuracy~~ — DEAD (exp-001: +0.26pp at N=762, n.s.)\\n2. Operating Regime Characterization — ALIVE but reframed (regime is vacuous)\\n3. C0 as Practical Diagnostic — ALIVE but weakened (necessary not sufficient)\\n\\n## Core Insight — D025 Pivot\\nSymbolic constraint consensus doesn't improve LLM reasoning — not because the idea is wrong, but because of a **capability trap**: the method needs output diversity (disagreement to resolve) AND high constraint quality (to resolve it correctly). These two conditions are inversely correlated in practice — models produce diverse outputs on hard tasks, but generate low-quality constraints on those same hard tasks. We provide the first systematic empirical study characterizing this trap across 4 reasoning domains and 7 models, formalizing it as the diversity-quality trade-off, and establishing practical guidance for when (not) to invest in symbolic aggregation methods.\\n\\n## Story Spine — D025 Analysis Paper\\n- **Problem**: Recent work proposes augmenting LLM reasoning with symbolic methods — extracting formal constraints from reasoning traces and using solvers for answer selection. But when should practitioners invest in such methods vs. simple majority voting?\\n- **Existing approaches & gaps**: SC (Wang et al. 2023) — pure voting. USC (Chen et al. 2023) — universal SC. Logic-LM (Pan et al. 2023), LINC (Olausson et al. 2023) — single-trace symbolic reasoning, no multi-trace aggregation. ORM/PRM (Cobbe et al. 2021, Lightman et al. 2023) — require trained verifiers. Weighted SC (Taubenfeld et al. 2024) — weighting without symbolic structure. None systematically characterize when symbolic aggregation helps vs. when it degenerates to voting.\\n- **Our framing**: We instantiate symbolic consensus as SICA (MAX-SAT over extracted FOL constraints) and systematically evaluate across 4 domains × 7 models. We find SICA ≈ SC everywhere, and identify a structural reason: the **capability trap**. Symbolic aggregation requires both output diversity (to have disagreement to resolve) AND constraint quality (to resolve it correctly). CPU-only reanalysis. Test: does weaker model → higher C0 → larger SICA gain? Validates C0-as-predictor claim.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 2, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-005\", \"name\": \"qwq_32b_operating_regime\", \"claim\": [2], \"description\": \"QwQ-32B negative results formatted for paper's Operating Regime Analysis section. Data exists from MVP phase (AIME, MATH, ProofWriter, FOLIO). No new GPU needed.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"Data from QwQ-32B MVP experiments: sica_aime30_v3 (AIME 22题, 0% multi-candidate), sica_proofwriter30_v2 (PW 16题, 18.75% multi-candidate), sica_folio30 (FOLIO 10题, 0% multi-candidate). Combined C0=3.6%, SICA≡SC across all domains.\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-006\", \"name\": \"c0_diagnostic_validation\", \"claim\": [3], \"description\": \"Plot C0 vs SICA-SC gap across all models and K values. Validate C0 as predictor. CPU-only analysis over exp-001/002/004/005 results.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\", \"exp-002\", \"exp-004\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-007\", \"name\": \"sica_72b_awq\", \"claim\": [2], \"description\": \"Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct AWQ 4-bit on 60 questions. Scaling analysis: high-baseline non-reasoning model. Within-Qwen scaling dimension.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 4, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D019 升级 P2→P1. 72B-AWQ 4-bit ~36GB weights + KV cache ≈ 50-60GB, 98GB RTX PRO 6000 单卡可放。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-008\", \"name\": \"constraint_quality_case_studies\", \"claim\": [1], \"description\": \"Qualitative analysis of extracted constraints on 5-10 representative questions. Are constraints semantically meaningful? Do excluded constraints correspond to reasoning errors?\", \"priority\": \"P2\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-009\", \"name\": \"overhead_analysis\", \"claim\": [1], \"description\": \"Wall-time breakdown per question: generation, constraint extraction, MaxSAT solving. Address 'is the overhead worth it' concern.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D021 升级 P2→P1. Cross-family validation: does C0 pattern hold outside Qwen? Eliminates 'Qwen-specific artifact' attack.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 1.5, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D021 新增. 必做——消除 Claim 2 致命弱点。Escalation: 若 C0>30% 且 gap>0 但 p>0.2，扩展到 200+ 题（~3h GPU，margin 允许）。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-011\", \"name\": \"sica_llama_8b\", \"claim\": [2, 3], \"description\": \"LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct on D012 60 questions. Second non-Qwen family. Combined with exp-010 gives 3-family coverage (Qwen/Mistral/LLaMA).\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 1.5, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D021 新增. 必做——3 家族是 EMNLP 最低门槛。需 HF_TOKEN（Meta license）或 ModelScope 镜像。Escalation 同 exp-010。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-012\", \"name\": \"gsm8k_pilot_14b\", \"claim\": [2, 3], \"description\": \"Qwen2.5-14B on GSM8K 30-question pilot (K=12). Cross-domain test: is C0 high only in restricted-answer-space domains (NLI 3-class) or also in open-answer math? If C0 low → C0=uncertainty signal (strengthens Claim 3). If C0 high → cross-domain win.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 1, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D021 新增. Reviewer 预测 C0<20% (14B too strong on GSM8K). Any result is publishable insight.\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-013\", \"name\": \"constraint_ablation\", \"claim\": [1, 2], \"description\": \"CPU-only ablation: SICA-MaxSAT vs SICA-count-only (constraint count per answer, no satisfiability) vs SICA-random-weight. Critical for D025 pivot: if MaxSAT ≈ count-only → aggregation mechanism is vacuous, confirming capability trap.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D025 升级 P1→P0. 现在是 make-or-break: 如果 MaxSAT = count-only → 证明 SAT 解算无贡献（capability trap 的 mechanism evidence）。必须用 exp-002 的 raw_constraints 数据。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-014\", \"name\": \"sica_deepseek_r1_llama_8b\", \"claim\": [2], \"description\": \"DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B on D012 60 questions. Second reasoning model data point with LLaMA base architecture: validates C0<5% generalizes beyond QwQ-32B AND eliminates 'still Qwen family' attack.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 2, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D021 新增. Reviewer 建议用 LLaMA 底座版本避免 Qwen 架构归属争议。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-015\", \"name\": \"logic_lm_baseline\", \"claim\": [1], \"description\": \"Logic-LM × K + majority vote baseline on FOLIO. Run Logic-LM style single-trace FOL verification K times, then majority vote. Isolates whether MAX-SAT multi-trace aggregation adds value beyond FOL extraction itself.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D024 新增. Dream 三档一致要求 Logic-LM/LINC 比较。CPU-only: 用 exp-001 已有 traces + FOL constraints 做单 trace verification then vote。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-016\", \"name\": \"weighted_sc_baseline\", \"claim\": [1, 3], \"description\": \"Weighted SC baseline (Taubenfeld et al. 2024 style): weight votes by trace confidence/length/perplexity. CPU-only reanalysis of exp-001/002 data. Tests if simple weighting achieves same tiebreak quality without MAX-SAT.\", \"priority\": \"P1\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\"], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D024 新增. Dream 提出 weighted SC 是最直接竞争 baseline。实现方式: (1) uniform weight (=SC), (2) length-weighted, (3) log-prob weighted (如 traces 有 logprobs), (4) constraint-count weighted (no SAT)。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-017\", \"name\": \"sica_strategyqa_14b\", \"claim\": [1, 2], \"description\": \"Qwen2.5-14B on StrategyQA 60 questions (K=12). Commonsense reasoning domain — high predicted C0 (35-50%) but implicit reasoning chains → low expected constraint quality. Tests capability trap in best-case-diversity scenario.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 1.5, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D025 新增. Reviewer 推荐 ROI 最高 benchmark。如 C0>30% 且 SICA≈SC → 直接证明 capability trap（diversity high but quality low → no gain）。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-018\", \"name\": \"sica_arc_challenge_14b\", \"claim\": [1, 2], \"description\": \"Qwen2.5-14B on ARC-Challenge 60 questions (K=12). Science reasoning, 4-choice format. Tests constraint mechanism in multi-choice scenario + different domain.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 1.5, \"deps\": [], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D025 新增. 4选1格式测试 constraint mechanism 泛化能力。与 FOLIO (3-class) + GSM8K (open) + StrategyQA (binary) 形成答案格式多样性。\"}, {\"id\": \"exp-019\", \"name\": \"constraint_quality_correlation\", \"claim\": [1, 2], \"description\": \"CPU-only analysis: compute constraint precision per domain × model, correlate with C0 and SICA-SC gap. Formalizes the capability trap as inverse C0-quality correlation. Uses data from exp-001/010/011/017/018.\", \"priority\": \"P0\", \"gpu_budget_hours\": 0, \"deps\": [\"exp-001\", \"exp-017\", \"exp-018\"], \"status\": \"planned\", \"note\": \"D025 新增. Hero figure (F2) 的数据来源。Constraint quality = (constraints consistent with ground truth) / (total constraints). 预期: high C0 domains (StrategyQA) have low quality, low C0 domains (math) have high quality but SICA=SC anyway.\"}], \"total\": 19}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}
